name: Shiori
message: "I was hoping... just maybe... that coming back here would jog my memory."

name: Shiori
message: "According to Ms. Librarian, I couldn't have been dead for more than ten years, since my sense of time is still intact."

name: Shiori
message: "So... I just kind of assumed it might've been around five years. You know, since I'm strangely fixated on that case."

name: Shiori
message: "But in reality... who knows? It could've been much longer."

name: Shiori
message: "My sister was so little back then. She might be a full-fledged adult by now."

name: Shiori
message: "Time marches on... and I'm the only one left behind. A little lonely, don't you think?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm just being sentimental. Sorry for dragging you into it."
